faq.q: Which communities does this page cover?
faq.a: Seven blocks: Langley; Surrey / Cloverdale; White Rock / South Surrey; Abbotsford; Chilliwack; Maple Ridge / Pitt Meadows; and Delta / Ladner / Tsawwassen — introduced by a decision framework covering commute, schools and catchments, price, and lifestyle.

faq.q: Does the page say which community is best?
faq.a: No — its stated position is that there is no objectively "best" community, only the best fit, decided by commute, schools, price and lifestyle, and it invites the reader to talk the differences through with Jared.

faq.q: Does the page tell me which school my child would attend in each community?
faq.a: No — the page advises checking actual catchment maps because catchments are tighter than buyers expect and one block can change the school, but it states no catchment result for any address, and none is given here.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
